title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode5 It's Showtime!

meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: A few weeks later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How was that?!
It's the perfect finale, no?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that was a wonderful scene.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can tell that you've all given this show everything you have. I'm sure it'll go great tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was really, really, really, super duper touched by it too!!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Thanks, Miku☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm a little bummed out about not being able to be in it when it really happens!! It's gonna be sooo good!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me☆ Tsukasa, would it be okay if we helped you out tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Help us out? Sure, but how?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we can actually...☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! Y-You can do that...?!
But this will mean that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see. If we time it properly, we just might be able to pull it off. It may be worth trying just for its sheer impact.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay☆ Then just leave everything to us tomorrow♪
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Tomorrow's finally the big day.
All of you, make sure to take breaks when you can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. We need to go into tomorrow in the best shape possible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we'll be ready for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This isn't just for you, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, this all began with lending you a hand when you needed our help...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it became much clearer after I saw how Seiryuin, the other troupes and all the staff felt.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This park is “a place that makes everyone smile.” None of us want that to change. Not ever...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want this park to be that kind of place too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This park made each of us all smile...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree with Nene. I want this park to be a place that's full of smiles and laughter.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene... Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And... Um... I'm so sorry, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you apologizing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that you wanted to win the Show Contest really bad and I ended up ruining that for you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, is that all?
Like I said before, it's okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I do feel a little sad...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*... I know...!!
I'm really, really, really sorry!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How many times are they gonna go through this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's good that they're being honest with each other.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But hold on there, Emu!
I am sad, but that doesn't matter!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The fact that I've taken a big step towards true stardom hasn't changed at all!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, winning the contest and appearing in a commercial as its star would've made my fame skyrocket...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But being a star also means knowing that making everybody smile and laugh takes top priority!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As long as I do that, I will become a star! So I'll say it again, it's completely okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Such is our troupe leader...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He knew exactly what needed to be said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, we've had a long day of practicing and rehearsing. Shall we head home and rest up for tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to make this show the greatest thing ever tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, see you all then!
The next day
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Mr. Riley, we appreciate you coming all this way today.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Yes, I've been looking forward to today.
I simply cannot wait to see this park of yours.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Also, we were aware that you spoke Japanese, but not quite to this degree.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I've been coming to Japan for quite a while now for both business and pleasure. Your grandfather, Rakunosuke, was also a very kind host.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I see.
I never knew that you and our family have been connected for so long.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now, we'd like to introduce you to the chairman of the Otori Group, Konosuke Otori.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
I am Konosuke Otori.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: It's you...! Your father told me so much about you! It's an honor to finally meet someone like you who's found success in so many different fields!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line:
I am honored to meet you as well.
I'm hoping that we'll be able to have a leisurely stroll around our park today.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
If you will, Mr. Riley...
We'd like to begin here. After you, sir...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: And this section will be at the center of the renovations. This monument isn't scheduled to be completed for another two years, but the rest will be ready in time...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, everything seems to be in order.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Next, we'd like for you to see the show stages. Today also happens to be the final day of the Show Contest, so each troupe will be giving their best possible performances.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: The Phoenix Stage in particular is one we are very proud of! I'm sure you won't be disappointed!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
There was even a time when I hoped to become an actor, so I absolutely love these kinds of shows!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: That dream didn't quite pan out, but that experience has stayed with me since...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Hm?
What's with this music...?!
“Hello, everyone...!!”
“Thank you for coming to Phoenix Wonderland today!!”
“As a little surprise, we'll be putting on a special show that you'll only be able to see today!”

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Hah! I must say, well played!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Having me see a show just before we get to one of the stages is quite impressive!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes!
Of course...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
What special show?
Was that on the schedule?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: No, this is news to me too...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Contact whoever's in charge.
And find the person making these announcements. They're using the PA system, so they must be in the control room.

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Is something about to start?

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: I wonder what they meant by their “special show”? They didn't even say where we could see it...
“Our special show's about to start and we'll be using this entire park as the stage!!”
“We ask that you please gather outside the Neo Phoenix Castle!”

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: What is the meaning of this show...?
